For pronunciation and definitions of 飲む – see the following entry.
【のむ】
[verb] 飲む, 呑む: to drink, to gulp, to swallow; to eat (soup)
[verb] 飲む, 喫む: (smoking) to smoke tobacco
[verb] to overwhelm, to engulf
[verb] to suppress, to keep down
[verb] 飲む, 呑む: to take (medicine)
[verb] 飲む, 呑む: to accept something like a demand or a condition
Alternative spellings
呑む, 喫む
(This term, 飲む, is an alternative spelling of the above term.)
